chunks.form: dated word-event superscription naming royal year, prophet, governor, and high priest
chunks.marker: Royal-year, month/day, word-event, mediation, and two named addressees create a threshold before the quoted claim.
chunks.rejected_alternative: Do not settle authorship, date, Persian chronology, office history, genealogy, or historicity.
chunks.risk: Identities, regnal synchronization, date conversion, Persian history, and office relations remain unresolved.

chunks.form: quoted communal timing claim answered by house contrast and first consider-your-ways scarcity catalogue
chunks.marker: The quoted claim is countered by the paneled-house question; repeated experiential clauses culminate in consider-your-ways.
chunks.rejected_alternative: Keep claim, rebuke, and scarcity together; decide no guilt, temple legitimacy, economic causation, date, or application.
chunks.risk: Voice extent, house referent, timing, scarcity rhetoric, ethics, and causation remain unresolved.

chunks.form: renewed consider-your-ways command with build purpose and drought explanation
chunks.marker: Renewed consider language opens ascend-bring-build imperatives; expected-much explanation and drought catalogue complete the address.
chunks.rejected_alternative: Do not atomize imperatives/crops, choose variants, or authorize temple, prosperity, punishment, environmental, labor, or economic doctrine.
chunks.risk: Glory wording, blowing-away phrase, drought wordplay, causation, ethics, and translation remain unresolved.

chunks.form: leader-and-remnant response through obedience, fear, assurance, spirit stirring, and work onset
chunks.marker: Leaders and remnant hear/obey/fear; messenger assurance and repeated stirred-spirit clauses lead to work, closed by a new date.
chunks.rejected_alternative: Preserve the scene without deciding agency, free will, chronology, historicity, leadership authority, or application.
chunks.risk: Messenger title, fear, spirit agency, remnant identity, labor sequence, and date remain unresolved.

chunks.form: second dated word-event joining former-glory questions, courage/work summons, covenant-spirit assurance, cosmic shaking, and latter-glory peace promise
chunks.marker: A new date resets discourse; look-back questions yield be-strong/work commands and with-you assurance, then yet-once shaking and glory/peace.
chunks.rejected_alternative: Do not proof-text 2:5-9, choose desire/treasures wording, identify its object, settle temple history, rank temples, or decide fulfillment.
chunks.risk: House/glory, covenant/spirit syntax, shaking, desire/treasures, silver/gold, peace, history, and reuse remain unresolved.

chunks.form: third dated word-event with paired priestly Torah cases and application to people, work, and offerings
chunks.marker: A new date commands inquiry; paired answers contrast holy transfer and corpse impurity before then-thus application.
chunks.rejected_alternative: Keep questions, answers, and application together; issue no halakhic, purity, ethnic, sacramental, or timeless ruling.
chunks.risk: Priestly authority, holy transfer, corpse impurity, contact chain, people/nation identity, work/offering scope, and uncleanness remain unresolved.

chunks.form: from-this-day retrospective review of foundation, failed yields, blows, seedlessness, and blessing pivot
chunks.marker: Repeated now-set-heart/from-this-day looks backward to pre-stone conditions; crop questions culminate in from-this-day-I-will-bless.
chunks.rejected_alternative: Do not force date conversion, foundation sequence, crop chronology, repentance verdict, prosperity mechanism, or blessing formula.
chunks.risk: Temporal syntax, foundation, measures, blight/mildew/hail, return, seed/crop status, blessing timing, and causation remain unresolved.

chunks.form: fourth same-day word-event moving from cosmic-political overthrow to Zerubbabel servant-and-signet close
chunks.marker: A second same-day word addresses Zerubbabel; shake/overturn/destroy culminates in on-that-day, my-servant, and signet.
chunks.rejected_alternative: Identify no throne, kingdom, battle, servant role, royal status, Davidic resolution, messianic fulfillment, chronology, or later claimant.
chunks.risk: Political imagery, violence, chronology, Zerubbabel identity, servant/signet wording, royal implications, and fulfillment remain unresolved.

hardest_boundary_order.why_hard: Covenant/spirit assurance flows into later-reuse-pressured shaking.
Impurity application may continue into temporal crop review.
Same-day second word follows blessing but changes addressee/subject.
Address ends and response begins within one event.
Work-onset date closes one scene and new date opens another.
Consider formula closes catalogue then repeats for command.
Glory/peace gives way to dated priestly inquiry while house concerns link them.
Overthrow culminates in distinct but dependent signet address.
